rules.alternatives: Voluntary national credentialing (VTNE) follows its own rules, not state law.
rules.notes: Wyoming does not license or register veterinary technicians; no state CE applies. W.S. 33-30-203(a)(ix) lets a veterinarian's aides, nurses, laboratory technicians and other employees assist under the veterinarian's supervision without a licence. A 2026 working draft to license veterinary technicians (26LSO-0017, W.S. 33-30-301 ff.) appears in the Legislature's interim committee files; it is not law.
rules.rule_quote: (ix) Any veterinary aide, nurse, laboratory technician, intern, or other employee of a licensed veterinarian from administering medication or rendering auxiliary or supporting assistance under the responsible supervision of such practicing veterinarian;
